text:
In the original tale, Kai’s sacrifice was absolute, but an alternative path exists where the ancient magic does not demand his erasure, but rather his mastery. As Kai reached for the core of the world’s energy, he did not let his spirit dissolve into the void. Instead, he anchored himself with the memories of those he loved, using his human connection as a tether to reality. The magic, recognizing the strength of his will rather than just his power, stabilized around him. Kai emerged from the surge not as a disembodied force, but as a mortal with a deeper, more nuanced understanding of the balance he had restored. He survived, bearing the scars of the battle but retaining his humanity, and went on to teach others how to harness the magic without losing themselves, ensuring the world’s safety through knowledge rather than singular sacrifice.

The capital of France is Paris.
